# XPorter

> Free desktop Chrome extension for exporting accessible X (Twitter) posts, personal bookmarks and account lists. Files are generated locally. No API key or subscription.

Current Store version verified on 2026-09-10: 2.0.0, updated 2026-09-09.
X rate limits and data availability apply. Completeness is not guaranteed.
This is an independent product, not an official X product.

## Product documentation
- [English homepage](https://lemelson.github.io/xporter-extension/): Capabilities, formats, setup, limits and FAQ.
- [Russian homepage](https://lemelson.github.io/xporter-extension/ru/): Russian product information.
- [Full plain-text reference](https://lemelson.github.io/xporter-extension/llms-full.txt): Product facts in English and Russian.
- [Privacy policy](https://lemelson.github.io/xporter-extension/privacy-policy.html): Local data, permissions and uninstall diagnostics.
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/jghmghialodmkmbcpfnhkgllkmjafmja): Current published package and installation.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Lemelson/xporter-extension): Source code; the main branch version may differ from the Store.

## Historical data
- [Growth snapshot](https://lemelson.github.io/xporter-extension/assets/growth-forecast.json): Weekly users through July 16, 2026, and model scenarios. These are not current user counts.
